name: Burke
description: Laquatus's nearly indestructible jack, killed by Balthor's spell.

description_citations.text: "Judgment (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Balthor lets Kamahl flee and sacrifices himself to destroy Burke as it suffocates him.
timeline.quote: Balthor let Kamahl flee into the forest and sacrificed himself

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "A New Home". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus controls Balthor and forces him to fight Kamahl; Balthor begs to be killed and Kamahl does so, then kills Laquatus.
timeline.quote: Balthor begged Kamahl to end his suffering

citation.text: "Balthor Rockfist", section "Balthor the Defiled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer creates Burke for Laquatus and heals Kamahl with snakeskin; Kamahl burns his skin off, ruining their friendship.
timeline.quote: His refusal to accept the Cabal's gifts ruined his and Chainer's friendship.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Dementist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer completes his initiation in Krosa with Kamahl and becomes a full dementia summoner able to master the Mirari; he creates Burke for Laquatus.
timeline.quote: he becomes a full-fledged dementia summoner.

citation.text: "Chainer's Torment", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus, trapped by Llawan's mages and failing diplomatically with the Order and the Cabal, goes to the mainland with Burke to retrieve the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Laquatus and his jack Burke go personally to the mainland to retrieve the Mirari

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the forest's edge Balthor holds off the pursuers and unleashes a great spell that kills himself and Burke; Laquatus discovers his troops were wiped out by Llawan's and forges a flimsy alliance with the Cabal and Order.
timeline.quote: the dwarf unleashes a great spell that kills them both.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
